Catch length distributions for the rule

Source: R/ldist.R
catch_ldist.Rd

Length distributions of the catch by year and 1 cm length (optionally also by gear) from a pax database, for the length-based components of the rfb and chr rules (mean length above L_c, the fishing pressure proxy and the harvest rate proxy).

The ldist table of a pax database built by pax::pax_from_mar() is already raised to the counted fish, so the lengths are only rounded here (pax::pax_ldist_scale_round()); the counts are not raised a second time.

The query runs in the database and only the summed result is collected. pax is only needed by this function (it is in Suggests); all other functions of the package take plain data frames.

Usage

catch_ldist(
  station,
  ldist,
  gears = NULL,
  year_start = NULL,
  sampling_type = c(1, 2, 8),
  by_gear = FALSE
)

Arguments

station

A tbl of the pax station table (e.g. dplyr::tbl(pcon, "station"), or a stock-specific accessor that fills in gear codes).

ldist

A tbl of the pax ldist table, unrounded (e.g. dplyr::tbl(pcon, "ldist")).

gears

mfdb gear codes to keep, or NULL for all gears.

year_start

First year to keep, or NULL for all years.

sampling_type

Sampling types of the stations (1, 2 and 8 are the commercial samples at sea and in port).

by_gear

If TRUE, keep the gear (mfdb_gear_code) as a column.

Value

A tibble with the columns year, (mfdb_gear_code,) length and n (numbers), sorted by these columns. Samples without the species (no length) are dropped.
